verdict: The Cognee-0.79 vs PseudoLife-0.50 BEAM-100K gap is mostly the reading stack, not the memory layer: swapping the 27B local reader for a frontier reader at identical 6-turn contexts is +0.120, and widening naive-RAG context from ~3.5K to ~22K tokens (Cognee's budget) adds another +0.130 - naive vector retrieval plus a frontier reader reaches 0.70 with no fact spine, no graph, no per-type prompts. Summarization (0.47) and event_ordering (0.52) stay broken at any budget, and abstention DEGRADES with volume (0.62 -> 0.50) - the three structural findings that survive the reading stack.

run.harness: evals/beam_reader_sweep.py (serve: CPU extraction-free banks, one top-48 serve sliced into budget arms; answer+judge: claude-opus-5 via headless CLI, same judge instrument as rejudge-opus5)
run.partial: 116 of 400 rows (chats 1-7); a usage-window outage stopped the sweep and 10 outage-tainted trailing rows were dropped. Serve phase is complete for all 400 rows, so completion resumes without re-retrieval.

paired_effects_n116.note: paired per-question against the qwen-reader rag row of rejudge-opus5 (identical questions, identical opus judge); 95% CIs

structural_findings.summarization: 0.38 -> 0.47 across the full budget sweep; coverage of whole-chat rubrics needs a mid-density layer (session digests), not more turns
structural_findings.event_ordering: 0.21 -> 0.52; improves with volume but stays the weakest type; extraction coverage + ordinal metadata, not answer-time synthesis (autopsied dead-end)
structural_findings.abstention: 0.62 -> 0.50 as volume grows - wider context invites confabulation; the small-context cortex arm's 0.95 is the differentiator this quantifies

decision: Stop the CLI sweep at n=116 (effects significant; remaining 284 rows would re-buy a table that gets re-measured anyway). Phase 1 (GPU-free code): contradiction-surfacing answer policy for BEAM, session/turn ordinals on stored turns, --rag-top-k knob. The single publishable full-tier measurement runs after the weekly usage reset with Phase-1 fixes in place; the hyb6 GPU run remains queued on user go-ahead.
caveats: Single replicate; CLI answerer/judge is not bit-reproducible. Deltas below the rejudge stability floor (mean |item delta| 0.073) are not findings.
Chats 1-7 only; per-type rows are n=10-12 - directional, not stable per-ability estimates.
Cognee's 0.79 remains a 20-question single-conversation protocol with rubric-shaped gold-label prompts; 0.70-at-their-budget here is naive RAG, not a like-for-like system comparison.
